Olga / Rafael,

Quick ops note so we have a record:
- Root cause: calendar .ics generator was inserting a short-lived Meet token for external guests when the recipient domain wasn't present in the legacy allowlist table. Token TTL was 4h, and our server-side rotation truncated the param when > 1024 chars.
- Short-term fix: issue Zoom-based ICS (attached) and extend TTL to 48h for the generated Meet token; prefer Zoom for external demos until allowlist is confirmed.
- Long-term: migrate ICS generation to the new calendar-service (PR 3412) which supports variable TTL and robust token encoding; Rafael please validate demo VM access for Finly so we don't have environment gating.

I'll update the calendar invite template and log a postmortem. Rafael — can you confirm the demo environment snapshot by EOD?
